title: ROUND takes ties away from zero on the 15-digit reading, so 1.005 rounds up
statement: A tie in ROUND goes away from zero, not to even: ROUND(2.5,0) is 3 and ROUND(-2.5,0) is -3. The tie is judged on the 15-digit reading of FN-ROUND-002, not on the stored value. So 1.005 and 2.675, whose binary64 values lie just below the decimal tie, count as ties: ROUND(1.005,2) is 1.01 and ROUND(2.675,2) is 2.68, where rounding the stored value would give 1 and 2.67.
basis: The readings below, typed as literals, and the family rule of FN-ROUND-002 over the recorded ROUND rows.
